stemMarkdown: In a race of 1200 m, the ratio of speeds of A and B is 13:2. If they start together, by what distance (in m) does A win when A finishes the race? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: In the time A covers 1200 m, B covers $\dfrac{2}{13} \times 1200 = 184.62$ m (same time, speeds proportional to distance covered). A wins by $= 1200 - 184.62 = 1015.38$ m.
